input_speed: pre-step car speed, as passed by racer.inputs inside racer.race

kernel.launch_count_scope: Pallas compute launches. The standalone call returns state alone; the readout is transferred from it, without a duplicate return.
kernel.could_not_do: A single launch needs a grid-wide barrier between convolutional populations, which the Triton backend does not expose. A three-launch version put the entire dense/readout in one CTA and serialized its weight reads; the fourth launch parallelizes the dense reduction across 64 input splits, each with four 32-feature CTAs.

timing_note: Host input indexing is outside the timer; readout transfer is inside. Scan time is synchronized wall time, not a separately profiled device-only time.

device_profile.definition: sum of GPU kernel durations / calls; excludes idle gaps and copies
